field_reference.id: stable catalog id referenced by the resolver, picker, and CLI
field_reference.kind: lora | controlnet | ip-adapter — the conditioning contract
field_reference.architecture: the SINGLE base architecture this adapter conditions; compatibility is adapter.architecture == model.architecture
field_reference.weight: consent weight contributed (none|low|high); effective op weight is max(op, adapters...)
field_reference.preprocessor: controlnet only: canny|depth|pose|segment|none — the analysis step that derives the control image from a raw input
field_reference.ready: execution proven on this architecture by an attended GPU run; ALWAYS false in the seed (no vaporware) — flipped in a later phase
field_reference.pending: for a not-ready adapter, what blocks proving it
field_reference.enabled: seed default enabled state (overlaid at runtime); an adapter must also be Ready before it is offered for execution
field_reference.source: fetch strategy: assets[] (single-file) | repo (diffusers snapshot, revision must be pinned before enable) | local_path
